key_findings: 5-fluoro-2-oxindole inhibited nociceptive, anxiety- and depressive-like behaviors in sciatic nerve-constricted mice, with suppressed microglial activation and activated Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 signaling.
5-fluoro-2-oxindole potentiated morphine antinociception by normalizing reduced MOR expression.
